list.title: My VPS
list.emptyDescription: Your first cell is one click away.
list.limitHint: You can have up to {{count}} VPS in this demo account.

create.title: Create VPS
create.subtitle: Pick the image, the plan and how you will log into the server.

auth.title: Access
auth.usernameHint: Your user will have admin access via {{sudo}}.
auth.noSavedKeys: No saved keys. Paste one below.
auth.saveKey: Save this key to my account
auth.passwordRequired: This image has a desktop: the password is needed for the on-screen login.
auth.sshPasswordAuthHint: When off, SSH only accepts keys (safer). You can change it later.
auth.rootPasswordHint: For the console and su; SSH login as root is always disabled.

details.title: Details
details.hostnameHint: Machine name on the network. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

summary.title: Summary
summary.demo: Simulated payment: no real charge is made.
summary.choose: Pick the image and the plan

lastError.PROVISION_FAILED: Creation failed. Nothing was kept on the server; you can delete it and try again.
lastError.ACTION_FAILED: The last action failed and the VM state could not be confirmed.
lastError.VM_MISSING: The virtual machine was not found on the server.
lastError.REINSTALL_FAILED: The reinstall failed. The IP is still reserved for this VPS: try reinstalling again or delete it.

toast.failed: The operation on {{hostname}} could not be completed.

detail.payPending: This VPS is waiting for the first month's payment.

shutdown.title: Shut down {{hostname}}?
shutdown.body: The system receives the shutdown signal (ACPI) and stops safely. If it does not respond within 60 s, the VM is stopped by force.

reboot.title: Reboot {{hostname}}?
reboot.body: The system restarts safely. Pending CPU and memory changes are applied on this reboot.

stop.title: Force stop {{hostname}}?
stop.body: Like pulling the plug: data not yet written to disk may be lost.

reset.title: Hard reset {{hostname}}?
reset.body: Restarts immediately, like pressing the reset button: unsaved data may be lost.

start.title: Power on {{hostname}}?
start.body: The VPS starts and becomes reachable in about half a minute.

actions.requested: Request sent: {{hostname}} will update on its own when it finishes.

overview.offline: Power on the VPS to see live usage.
overview.sshHint: Run it in your computer's terminal. Login uses your SSH key or password, depending on the access settings.
overview.rootSsh: SSH login as root: always disabled
overview.sudo: Your user administers the system with {{sudo}}.
overview.pendingReboot: The new CPU and memory resources will apply on the next reboot from the panel.

timeline.title: Creating your VPS
timeline.subtitle: This takes about a minute. You can leave the page: creation continues.

console.notRunning: Power on the VPS to use the console.
console.hint: Click the screen to type. Server images show the text login; the Desktop image shows the graphical login.
console.failed: Could not connect to the console.
console.serialHint: Terminal on the VM serial port: select to copy and paste as usual. If the login prompt does not show up, press Enter.
console.failedDetail: Could not open the console in this browser ({{detail}}).

connections.title: Console connections
connections.fullHint: Limit reached: end a connection to open another one.

metrics.empty: No data for this period yet.

access.notRunning: Power on the VPS to change access: changes are made inside it, without a reboot.
access.passwordDescription: Takes effect immediately, without a reboot. Favo does not store the password.
access.sshDescription: When off, SSH only accepts keys (safer). SSH login as root is always disabled.
access.sshHintNoPassword: To log in with a password, first set a password for your user.
access.keysDescription: The key is appended to your user's authorized_keys, keeping the existing ones.
access.saveKey: Also save it in my account

settings.renameDescription: Changes the hostname inside the VPS immediately, without a reboot.
settings.resizeDescription: CPU and memory apply on the next reboot from the panel; the disk grows immediately. The disk cannot be shrunk.
settings.diskSmaller: Disk smaller than the current one
settings.resizeConfirmBody: The difference prorated to the days left in the month (at most {{amount}}, simulated) becomes an invoice when the change finishes.
settings.notAvailable: Available with the VPS on or off, with no other operation in progress.
settings.reinstallDescription: Erases the disk and installs the image again (the same or another one). The IP, hostname and plan are kept.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deleting erases the VPS and all its data. This cannot be undone.
danger.confirmBody: Type the hostname to confirm. The VM and its disk will be erased and the IP returns to the pool.

billing.renewal: The renewal invoice ({{amount}}) is open. Pay by {{date}} to keep the VPS from being suspended.
billing.upgrade: The plan change difference ({{amount}}) is open until {{date}}.
billing.suspended: This VPS was suspended for non-payment and its machine was shut down. Pay the renewal by {{date}} to reactivate it; after that, it will be deleted.

reinstall.title: Reinstall {{hostname}}
reinstall.subtitle: Choose the image and access again, as when creating it.
reinstall.warning: Everything on the disk will be erased. This cannot be undone.
reinstall.kept: Kept: the IP {{ip}}, the hostname, the {{plan}} plan and the period already paid.
reinstall.confirmHelp: Reinstalling takes about a minute; the VPS is offline during that time.
reinstall.notAllowed: This VPS cannot be reinstalled right now. Wait for the current operation to finish.
